[Table]{.lit-num}

[Fully connected. Glacier mass balance, French Alps, from features: error 0.51 m w.e. per year on held-out glaciers, against 0.74 for Lasso.]{.lit-msg}

[Bolibar et al. (2020). *The Cryosphere*, 14, 565–584. CC BY 4.0.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[Grid]{.lit-num}

[Convolutional. El Niño from ocean maps: useful skill for about 1.5 years, above dynamical forecast systems.]{.lit-msg}

[Ham, Kim & Luo (2019). *Nature*, 573, 568–572.]{.lit-cite}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.lit-card}
[Sequence]{.lit-num}

[Recurrent (LSTM). Floods in ungauged rivers, 5 days ahead, as reliable as same-day global nowcasts; operational in over 80 countries.]{.lit-msg}

[Nearing et al. (2024). *Nature*, 627, 559–563.]{.lit-cite}
:::

::: {.lit-card}
[Graph]{.lit-num}

[Graph network. 10-day global weather on a mesh of cells: better than ECMWF's deterministic forecast on 90% of 1,380 targets.]{.lit-msg}

[Lam et al. (2023). *Science*, 382, 1416–1421.]{.lit-cite}
:::
